description: Read Kemp's tally, and will hang Tuesday and the sixteenth.
name: Abel Garnish

description: His hand is the one in the picture.
name: Cuthbert Burbage

description: Envied Thursday's house, and named no price.
name: James Burbage

description: The baize under the silver is his. He is not the hand.
name: John Heminges

description: In the room. Her swear is in Heminges's mouth, where the count already put it.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Called emptying a house the rarer art, and stayed out of the king.
name: Will Kemp

description: Looked, and did not touch the lid.
name: William Shakespeare
